title: TeleportationDeluxe
description: A simple plugin that allows you to use Teleportation commands (TPA, Warp, etc.)
body:
## TeleportationDeluxe

TeleportationDeluxe is a modern, lightweight teleportation plugin for PaperMC servers designed as a full upgrade over traditional TPA, home, and warp systems.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📡 Teleport Requests (TPA)

* `/tpa <player>` – Send a teleport request
* `/tpaccept` – Accept a request
* `/tpadeny` – Deny a request
* Fully player-to-player teleport system

---

### 🏠 Homes System

* `/createhome <name>` – Create a personal home
* `/home <name>` – Teleport to your home
* `/homes` – List all saved homes
* `/delhome <name>` – Remove a home
* Supports multiple homes per player
* Case-sensitive home names

---

### 🌍 Warps System

* `/createwarp <name>` – Create a server warp
* `/warp <name>` – Teleport to a warp
* `/warp` – View all available warps
* Player-owned warp system
* Public teleport locations for servers

---

### 🛠 Admin & Utility

* `/teleportationdeluxe reload` – Reload configuration
* `/teleportationdeluxe version` – View plugin version
* `/teleportationdeluxe author` – View author
* `/teleportationdeluxe modrinth` – Open project page
* Aliases: `/td`, `/tele`, `/teleportation`

---

## 🧱 Commands Overview

```text
/tpa <player>
/tpaccept
/tpadeny

/createhome <name>
/home <name>
/homes
/delhome <name>

#createwarp <name>
/warp [name]

/td reload
/td version
/td author
/td modrinth
```

## 🚀 Planned Features

* Teleport warmups (movement cancel system)
* Teleport cooldown system
* GUI-based warp selector
* `/back` command (death/teleport history)
* SQLite / MySQL support
* Velocity cross-server compatibility

---

## 💡 Why TeleportationDeluxe?

TeleportationDeluxe focuses on being:

* Cleaner than traditional Essentials-style systems
* Easier to expand for developers
* Lightweight and server-friendly
* Fully customizable and modular
